title: Deceitful Hearts, Blessed Trust

questions.question: "The sin of Judah is written with a pen of...; with a point of... it is engraved on the tablet of their heart, and on the horns of their altars,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 17:1 (ESV): "The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron; with a point of diamond it is engraved on the tablet of their heart,"

questions.question: "O my mountain in the field, your... and all your treasures I will give for spoil as the price of your high places for sin throughout all your territory."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 17:3 (ESV): "your wealth and all your treasures I will give for spoil"

questions.question: "Cursed is the man who trusts in man and makes... his strength, whose heart turns away from the Lord."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 17:5 (ESV): "Cursed is the man who trusts in man and makes flesh his strength,"

questions.question: What is the man like who trusts in man and makes flesh his strength?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 17:6 (ESV): "He is like a shrub in the desert, and shall not see any good come."

questions.question: "Blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord, whose... is the Lord."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 17:7 (ESV): "Blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord, whose trust is the Lord."

questions.question: What is the man like who trusts in the Lord?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 17:8 (ESV): "He is like a tree planted by water, that sends out its roots by the stream,"

questions.question: "The heart is... above all things, and desperately...; who can understand it?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 17:9 (ESV): "The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately sick; who can understand it?"

questions.question: "I the Lord search the heart and test the mind, to give every man according to his..., according to the fruit of his deeds."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 17:10 (ESV): "to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his deeds."

questions.question: What bird is used to describe a man who gets riches but not by justice?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 17:11 (ESV): "Like the partridge that gathers a brood that she did not hatch, so is he who gets riches but not by justice;"

questions.question: "O Lord, the hope of Israel, all who forsake you shall be put to shame; those who turn away from you shall be written in the..., for they have forsaken the Lord, the fountain of living water."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 17:13 (ESV): "those who turn away from you shall be written in the earth,"

questions.question: "Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved, for you are my..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 17:14 (ESV): "save me, and I shall be saved, for you are my praise."

questions.question: Which day did the Lord specifically command the people of Judah not to carry a burden on, or bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 17:21 (ESV): "Take care for the sake of your lives, and do not bear a burden on the Sabbath day or bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem."

questions.question: If the people listen and keep the Sabbath day holy, who shall enter the gates of the city, riding in chariots and on horses?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 17:25 (ESV): "then there shall enter by the gates of this city kings and princes who sit on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses,"

questions.question: If they do not listen to keep the Sabbath day holy, what will the Lord kindle in its gates that shall not be quenched?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 17:27 (ESV): "then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem and shall not be quenched."

questions.question: From where did the Lord say people would come bringing burnt offerings, sacrifices, grain offerings, and frankincense?
options: The cities of Judah and the places around Jerusalem
The land of Egypt and Babylon
The tribes of Israel in the north
questions.correctAnswer: The cities of Judah and the places around Jerusalem
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 17:26 (ESV): "And people shall come from the cities of Judah and the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, from the Shephelah, from the hill country, and from the Negeb,"

key_verse_text: "Blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord, whose trust is the Lord. He is like a tree planted by water, that sends out its roots by the stream, and does not fear when heat comes, for its leaves remain green, and is not anxious in the year of drought, for it does not cease to bear fruit."
